findings.claim: The new table rows describe the walk order but the bridged-memory row that follows still reads as if the bridge refusal applies to any memory whose import_map row names an observation with a page. It does not say that this holds only when the memory has no page of its own, so the guide can be read two ways on a memory that has both. The two new rows resolve this by implication, so it is only a minor clarity gap. This is docs-only with no behavioral change.

evidence: Diff changes only two documentation/spec files; no code is touched, so no runtime regression is possible from this commit.

The Previously notes match the guide text, so the documented before/after behavior is internally consistent.
